import json
import httpx
from lfx.custom.custom_component.component import Component
from lfx.io import DropdownInput, MultilineInput, Output, StrInput
from lfx.schema import Data


class KOLBM25Matcher(Component):
    display_name = "KOL BM25 Matcher"
    description = "Run the API's versioned KOL matching algorithm."
    documentation = "https://docs.langflow.org/components-custom-components"
    icon = "waypoints"
    name = "KOLBM25Matcher"
    inputs = [
        MultilineInput(name="brand_profile_json", display_name="Brand Profile JSON", value='{"brand_name":"Traveloka","topics":["travel"]}'),
        MultilineInput(name="creators_json", display_name="Creators JSON", value='[{"username":"travel.with.ink","bio":"travel creator","topic_tags":["travel"]}]'),
        DropdownInput(name="algorithm_key", display_name="Algorithm", options=["bm25_v2_lekcut"], value="bm25_v2_lekcut"),
        StrInput(name="api_url", display_name="Matcher API URL", value="http://api:8000/api/matching/score", advanced=True),
    ]
    outputs = [Output(name="matches", display_name="Matches", method="run_match")]
    def run_match(self) -> Data:
        brand_profile = json.loads(self.brand_profile_json)
        creators = json.loads(self.creators_json)
        if not isinstance(brand_profile, dict) or not isinstance(creators, list):
            raise ValueError("Brand profile must be an object and creators must be an array")
        response = httpx.post(self.api_url, json={"brand_profile": brand_profile, "creators": creators, "algorithm_key": self.algorithm_key}, timeout=60.0)
        response.raise_for_status()
        result = response.json()
        self.status = f"Matched {len(result.get('matches', []))} creators with {result.get('algorithm_key', self.algorithm_key)}."
        return Data(data=result)
